user.title: Adaptive Light
user.description: A zone, or the outdoor radiation used when a zone has no lux sensor.

zone.title: Zone
zone.description: One zone, on its own. When someone is present, these lamps turn on when the weighted average of the lux estimate over the window is below the threshold, and turn off when that average rises above the threshold. Newer samples weigh more. A falling average does not turn them off. The window defaults to 10 minutes. Threshold 0 follows presence only. When all sensors have been off for the timeout, the lamps turn off. Night mode, during its window, turns them off after an hour without new movement and turns them on again when movement returns. Color temperature in kelvin is sent when it is set; otherwise an RGB color is sent when it is set. Brightness is sent when it is set. While the zone keeps the lamp on, that color is sent again if the lamp is repainted, and Adaptive Lighting is asked not to paint over it. Empty leaves color and brightness to Adaptive Lighting. Another zone is added as another entry.

outdoor.title: Outdoor light
outdoor.description: Used when a zone has no lux sensor. The estimate is outdoor radiation in W/m² times this factor. An empty sensor leaves those zones on presence only.

momentary.title: Momentary action
momentary.description: On trigger the lamp's current state is saved, the color is applied, and after the duration the snapshot is restored or the lamp turns off. A sensor or button trigger already stored on this action is kept.
